title: Business Head
description:
We're Hiring: Business Head
 



  





 📍 Location: Coimbatore
 



 🏢 Full\-time \| On\-site
 



  





 Aurawill is one of India's fastest\-growing nutrition brands, making traditional, science\-backed nutrition simple and accessible for modern families.
 



  





 In just over a year, we've earned the trust of 1,00,000\+ customers and are expanding rapidly across D2C, marketplaces, quick\-commerce and retail.
 



  





 Aurawill is looking for a strong commercial Business Head to own the Brand’s business end\-to\-end and take responsibility for scaling the brand. This role is for someone who is ready to own the full business rather than a single functional vertical.
 



  





**The oppurtunity:** 




 Aurawill is a natural health foods brand with an ambition to build a differentiated, trusted and scalable consumer business. The Business Head will be responsible for translating the brand ambition into business growth i.e owning the P\&L, shaping strategy, setting priorities and leading the teams and functions required to deliver the plan.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




**· P\&L and Business Strategy:** 
 Own the overall Aurawill P\&L and business plan; set revenue, gross margin, contribution, profitability and growth priorities; identify the biggest business levers and allocate resources and budgets accordingly.
 



**· Sales channels:** 
 Own the D2C channel and other online/offline channels of business end\-to\-end including acquisition, retention, and channel profitability. Build a scalable growth engine rather than optimising only for topline.
 



**· Marketing \& Brand:** 
 Partner closely with the marketing team to translate the brand strategy into consumer growth. Own the commercial outcomes of marketing investments while protecting long\-term brand equity, positioning and consumer relevance.
 



**· Supply Chain \& Operations:** 
 Own the operating rhythm from demand planning and procurement through production, inventory, fulfilment, quality and customer experience.
 



**· Finance \& Business Management:** 
 Work closely with finance to build budgets, forecasts, monthly business reviews, scenario building and investment cases.
 



**· People \& Organisation:** 
 Lead and align cross\-functional teams across sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, operations and other business\-critical functions. Build a high\-accountability culture with clear goals, ownership and operating cadence.
 



**· Growth \& Innovation:** 
 Identify new consumer needs, occasions, products, channels and partnerships that can materially expand the business
 



  





**What we are looking for :** 




 · Owned a D2C business, category, brand, business unit with full P\&L responsibility.
 



 · Strong general\-management orientation: able to lead revenue, margins, operations and people rather than operating only within one function.
 



 · Demonstrated ownership of business numbers and comfort being accountable for revenue, gross margin, contribution and profitability.
 



 · Strong understanding of D2C growth \& metrics \- acquisition, conversion, retention, repeat, CAC, bleded CAC, LTV, AOV \& Channel mix.
 



 · Experience leading cross\-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across marketing, sales, supply chain, finance and operations.
 



 · Strong commercial judgement: able to distinguish between growth that creates value and growth that merely creates topline.
 



 · Comfort working in an entrepreneurial environment with hands on experience where resources and budgets are tight
 



 · Data\-fluent and financially rigorous, while retaining strong instinct for consumer and market.
 



 · High ownership, speed of decision\-making and willingness to execute when needed.
 



  





**Ideal Background:** 




 We are interested in candidates who may currently be working as a D2C / E\-commerce Business Head, Category Head, P\&L Owner, General Manager, Head of Growth or an equivalent role in a consumer business.
 



 Minimum 8\-10 years of relevant experience from D2C\-first consumer brands, FMCG, food \& beverage, health \& wellness, beauty \& personal care, nutrition, consumer tech or other categories where the candidate has had genuine commercial ownership and proven cross\-functional leadership for a few years.
 



 Entreprenuers who have built and scaled consumer businesses in the past are also welcome to apply.
 



*Preferred but not mandatory:* 
 From Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school in India
 



  





**What you will get from us :** 




 · Complete ownership and responsibility of business coupled with people leadership responsibility for a new\-age brand that wants to build strong equity in the foods and nutrition business
 



 · Meaningful ownership in terms of ESOP to share rewards and success of the business
 



 · Freedom to experiment and decision\-making autonomy
 



 · A company with humble\-people with good intention and make good quality products that serve consumer health
 



**The ideal Candidate:** 




 This role is for someone who wants to build a business, not simply manage a function; be comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and be willing to take ownership when something is not working.

title: Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
**Job Position: Marketplace Growth Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Peelamedu locality, Coimbatore
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 3–4\+ years
 



  





**About Nap Chief** 





 Nap Chief is a fast\-growing D2C kidswear brand. We sell through our own website (napchief.com) and all
 **major marketplaces including Myntra, FirstCry, and Amazon** 
 . At Nap Chief, we're redefining kids' wear for a new generation of parents. We craft premium, super\-soft clothing that kids love to wear and parents trust. Our mission is to empower the young generation and we are looking for you to join forces with us to conquer this mission.
 



  





**About the Role** 





 You will own Nap Chief's entire marketplace business — revenue and profitability across every platform, the catalogue on each, pricing and event strategy, platform advertising, inventory sell\-through, and platform relationships. The mandate is to grow marketplace revenue while keeping contribution margin (CM2\) intact — growth that loses money at the SKU level does not count.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




***P\&L ownership per platform:***



* Own revenue and CM2 targets for each marketplace: Myntra, FirstCry, Amazon, and any platform we operate on
* Maintain SKU\-level P\&L visibility: selling price, discounts, platform commissions and fees, returns, ad spend, and resulting contribution margin — per platform, per month
* Report weekly on platform performance, drivers, and actions in the business review



***Catalog and content:***



* Own listing quality on every platform: product titles, descriptions, keywords, imagery, size charts, and A\+/enhanced content where available
* Own catalog completeness and hygiene: new products listed on time, correct attribution, active selection maximized, and ratings/reviews monitored with corrective action on recurring complaints



***Pricing, discounting, and events:***



* Own platform\-level pricing and discount strategy, including price parity decisions across channels
* Own sale\-event participation decisions — Myntra EORS, Amazon sale events, FirstCry sales, and category\-level promotions — evaluated with margin math before committing, and planned end\-to\-end (stock, pricing, visibility) when we participate



***Platform advertising:***



* Own marketplace ad budgets and execution: Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products/Brands), Myntra PLA, and equivalent programs on other platforms
* Manage ad efficiency at the SKU and category level as part of overall CM2, not as a separate silo



***Inventory and operations:***



* Plan sell\-through with the fashion buyer: demand forecasts by SKU and platform, stock allocation across platforms and fulfilment models, replenishment for winners, and clearance paths for slow movers
* Monitor and control returns and RTO rates; diagnose causes (sizing, quality, expectation mismatch) and fix them with the relevant team
* Own account health on each platform: fill rates, SLA compliance, penalties, claims, and payment reconciliation



***Portfolio and expansion:***



* Make SKU\-level portfolio calls each season: which styles to scale, fix, or delist
* Evaluate and recommend new platform entries (Ajio, Hopscotch, Nykaa Kids, quick commerce) with a clear business case, and own the launch when approved



***Relationships and team:***



* Own relationships with category managers and platform POCs — visibility slots, event access, and issue resolution
* Manage two marketplace associates: weekly plans, execution review, and development



  





**KPIs you own:** 



* Marketplace revenue vs plan, with CM2 held at target
* Sell\-through rate and inventory health
* Returns/RTO rate
* Ad efficiency (platform ACOS/ROAS within CM2 targets)



  





**Requirements:** 



* 3–4\+ years managing marketplace or category P\&Ls — at a marketplace itself (Myntra, Amazon, FirstCry category teams) or at a brand selling at scale on them
* **MBA required** 
 , with a demonstrably sharp, analytical mindset — this role needs someone who can move fast and think clearly under ambiguity
* Strong data analysis: comfortable in spreadsheets with SKU\-level data, able to compute and act on contribution margin in real time
* Working knowledge of seller platforms and tooling: Amazon Seller Central, Myntra Partner Portal or equivalents, and marketplace advertising consoles
* Demonstrated results: revenue or profitability improvements personally driven, with numbers
* Experience coordinating inventory with buying/planning teams
* Adaptability to a fast\-moving assortment: many styles, seasonal drops, and a growing brand's pace

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Associate Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high\-net\-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibility**
* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long\-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements


**Pro\-tip : Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.**
**Eligibility \& Educational Qualifications**
* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4\-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high\-net\-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience
* AMFI IRDA NISM XXI A (PMS Certification) and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) or equivalent certification or equivalent demonstrable experience where required by the market.


**Additional Information**
 Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.
   

  

 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Fortinet’s Integrated, AI\-driven Security platform is a Unified, Integrated cybersecurity platform that spans Network, Core, Endpoints, Applications, Cloud, etc.

More than 890,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry.

The role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity products, partner ecosystems, and enterprise customer needs. * Leverage Tech\-Days/ Fast track training sessions, to ensure customers have a complete solution understanding of various Fortinet solution to meet their use\-cases
* Leverage partners extensively to cross\-sell to existing Accounts \& penetrate into net new Accounts
* Understand customer security needs, pain points, and ongoing threats; position the right cybersecurity solutions.
* Conduct regular account reviews, QBRs, and roadmap discussions with customers.
* Collaborate with pre\-sales/SE teams to deliver demos, POCs, and solution designs.

* Support partners with deal strategy, pricing, proposals, and competitive positioning.
* Ensure channel partners are aligned with the company’s product roadmap, promotions, and incentive programs.
* Resolve channel conflicts and ensure smooth deal registration.

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.
